name: Petunia's Spooky Journey
source:
Play as Petunia as she and her friends go trick or treating through the village, collecting as much candy as possible with absolutely no adult supervision. Surely nothing can go wrong on Halloween, the safest night of the year.

[From [url=https://carnalmantrap.itch.io/petunias-spooky-journey]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
扮演Petunia，和朋友们一起在村里挨家挨户讨糖，尽可能多收集糖果，全程没有任何大人看管。万圣节是一年中最安全的夜晚，肯定不会出问题。

[来源：[url=https://carnalmantrap.itch.io/petunias-spooky-journey]Itch.io[/url]]
